scope.target: Cross-sectional descriptive system-segregation method adaptation on exactly 40 released movie-watching derivatives
not_claimed: Richardson original processing or endpoint replication
verified anatomical equivalence between MNI templates
scope.outcome_constraints: No required effect sign, magnitude, significance, participant variability, ranking or prose keywords

source.manifest_identity: The separately frozen public source_manifest.json and verify_staged authenticate the exact 86-entry runtime bundle. Never substitute the earlier authentication-evidence manifest.
source.paths: 83 exact original basenames at the source root; three provenance/* files; source_manifest.json. No reduced-confound cache, extra files, symlinks or special files.
source.source_identity: Authenticate exact relative paths, sizes and SHA256 before numerical use; preserve original bytes. Participant keys are literal sub-pixarNNN strings, never digit-stripped.

cohort.source_row_index: Zero-based original data-row index, excluding header
cohort.selection: Exactly the declared IDs; other source-table people are not analysis exclusions; no new participant or frame exclusions

observed_structure.atlas_labels: Finite exactly integral voxel values 0..100; LUT has one exact original row for each label 1..100
observed_structure.selected_confound_values: All 15 selected columns finite for all 168 rows and all 40 people

source.units_limitation: BOLD header unit codes are unknown. Its fourth zoom is the stored number 1, not evidence of TR=1 second. README supports a 4-mm spatial grid and the acquisition article describes TR=2 seconds contextually; no temporal frequency filter or seconds-based operation is performed. Preserve measured header units and scaling without inventing physiological signal units.

geometry.transfer: Identity-world nearest-neighbor atlas-label transfer to original BOLD voxel centres; never interpolate BOLD values
geometry.mapping: For integer target voxel v=(i,j,k,1), source atlas coordinate a=inv(A_atlas) @ A_bold @ v, computed in float64. If any a_d is outside the continuous closed interval [0,atlas_shape[d]-1], label=0. Otherwise nearest integer=floor(a_d+0.5), with the stated float64 addition. Read that original atlas voxel label.
geometry.source_frame_convention: Zero-based original BOLD frame indices 0..167; no discarded or reordered frames in numerical construction
geometry.roi_convention: Original LUT IDs 1..100, background 0 excluded. Network is the exact third underscore-separated token of labels 7Networks_{LH|RH}_{network}_... .
geometry.coverage: Every original cortical label 1..100 must occur on the transferred target grid. Missing support is SOURCE_PRECONDITION_FAILURE; no common-ROI or participant-specific selection.
geometry.spatial_limit: Atlas source is MNI152NLin6Asym; BOLD derivatives identify MNI152NLin2009cAsym. Identity-world transfer is a declared template approximation, not an estimated nonlinear anatomical registration.

preprocessing.scaled_data: Read calibrated/scaled NIfTI values using each image proxy's effective slope and intercept; promote to float64. Do not infer physical signal units, use stored int8 codes or replace nonfinite values.
preprocessing.raw_mean: For each person/frame/label, arithmetic mean of all target-grid voxels with that label. All 40 full decoded BOLD arrays and all selected confound values must be finite; no hidden within-parcel voxel selection.
preprocessing.confound_missingness: Exactly 168 rows, selected columns unique and finite. Any missing/invalid/nonfinite selected value is SOURCE_PRECONDITION_FAILURE; no imputation. Unselected original columns are not added to the model.
preprocessing.detrend: For each signal or selected confound column x: x0=x-mean(x); t=arange(T)-mean(arange(T)); u=t/sqrt(sum(t*t)); D(x)=x0-u*(u.T@x0). Apply independently to both raw parcel means and selected confounds.
preprocessing.confound_standardization: After detrending, recenter each nuisance column; population SD=sqrt(mean(centered_column**2)); replace SD<eps64 by 1 only for scaling, then divide. This does not impute source values.
preprocessing.nuisance_projection: Pivoted economic QR of the standardized nuisance matrix C[:,pivot]=Q@R. Retain Q columns whose corresponding abs(diag(R))>100*eps64; rank is the number retained. Residual=D(raw_mean)-Q_keep@(Q_keep.T@D(raw_mean)). No extra intercept or regressors.
preprocessing.canonical_support: Recenter residuals; define residual_sd and original raw_mean SD using ddof=1 across all 168 frames. Every participant/ROI must satisfy residual_sd > 1e-12*max(1,raw_sd). Otherwise SOURCE_PRECONDITION_FAILURE, never parcel/person dropping, zero-filled correlation or an outcome-specific numerical floor.
preprocessing.standardized_clean: Divide each recentered residual vector by its sample SD (ddof=1). This standardized vector is the source-bound downstream computational primitive.

acceptance_basis.canonical_source: Verifier authenticates original files and independently reconstructs exact geometry/raw means/cleaning. Source-defined support and nuisance rank are canonical pre-serialization quantities and explicitly declared here.
acceptance_basis.raw_receipts: Submitted raw means and raw/residual SD diagnostics are source-bound receipts only; do not re-clean their rounded values.
acceptance_basis.accepted_primitives: After matching complete axes and source-close standardized_clean vectors, cast submitted standardized_clean to float64 and derive every downstream field from those accepted vectors. Require finite values and strictly positive own centered L2 for every vector.
acceptance_basis.single_recomputation: Compute r, z, positive_z, pair sums/means/ratio and all group statistics once from accepted standardized_clean. Compare each submitted derived field directly to that same calculation, not to recursively rounded r/z/ratio receipts. No second secret reference FC, sign, ratio, cohort mean or contrast target.
acceptance_basis.near_boundary: A source-close vector may produce a different exact-zero downstream edge or within mean. Accept only coherent own-derived values/status/null propagation; do not silently floor denominators or impose original-outcome categories.
acceptance_basis.implementation_equivalence: Equivalent numerical libraries, coherent axis/table reordering and reasonable numeric serialization are accepted within the public field tolerances. Exact software versions are not graded. No claim about historical execution order is certified.

endpoint.edge_family: All 4950 unique unordered label pairs (i,j),1<=i<j<=100. Default order is ascending i then j; explicit edge axes permit any coherent permutation. No diagonal or duplicated symmetric pairs.
endpoint.pearson: For each accepted standardized vector, subtract its own mean. r_ij=dot(centered_i,centered_j)/(L2_i*L2_j). Finite roundoff excursions of absolute r above 1 by at most 1e-12 are clamped to [-1,1]; larger excursions fail.
endpoint.fisher: z=atanh(clip(r,-0.999999,0.999999)); positive_z=max(z,0). Raw r remains the unclipped-to-0.999999 Pearson receipt.
endpoint.partition: Within if original LUT network(i)==network(j), otherwise between. Pool all pairs in each family; do not first average systems equally or remove nonpositive edges.
endpoint.primary: within_sum=sum(positive_z[within]); between_sum=sum(positive_z[between]); mean_within=within_sum/n_within; mean_between=between_sum/n_between; numerator=mean_within-mean_between; segregation=numerator/mean_within.
endpoint.undefined: If mean_within is exactly zero, segregation is undefined with status=zero_within_mean, CSV blank and JSON null. Keep all other finite counts/sums/means/numerator. Otherwise status=ok. No epsilon denominator floor.
endpoint.natural_domains: Counts exact/nonnegative; raw/residual SD nonnegative; saved Pearson in [-1,1]. Fisher z magnitude and positive_z upper bound are atanh(.999999), with serialization allowance derived.atol+derived.rtol*atanh(.999999) solely at that cap; each field must still match its own recomputed value under the unchanged derived tolerance. Positive_z/sums/means remain strictly nonnegative. Defined segregation<=1 with no arbitrary lower bound. All other required numbers finite.
endpoint.optional_sensitivity: Signed or positive-pair-excluded variants may be separate named optional extras. Neither is a substitute for any required primary field; absence is not penalized.

group_summary.aggregation: Equal participant arithmetic means, never edge/frame pseudo-replication. Keep all 40, child31/adult9; n_defined and n_undefined explicitly counted.
group_summary.group_record: For cohort and each group, if every member has defined segregation, mean=mean(S), sample_variance=sum((S-mean)**2)/(n-1), status=ok. If any member is undefined, mean and sample_variance null, status=undefined_member. Do not replace the requested full-group endpoint by a finite-subset mean.
group_summary.contrast: If both entire groups defined, estimate=adult_mean-child_mean; se=sqrt(adult_sample_variance/9+child_sample_variance/31); ci95=[estimate-1.96*se,estimate+1.96*se],status=ok. If either group undefined, estimate,se,ci95 null,status=undefined_member. Exact constant group values have variance0 and a zero-width contribution; no arbitrary dispersion gate.
group_summary.interpretation: Descriptive normal-Wald contrast in a selected cross-sectional convenience cohort, with nine adults/shared movie and age-related confounding; not within-person change or a causal estimate.

tolerances.comparison: abs(actual-expected)<=atol+rtol*abs(expected), with reference arguments as explicitly defined by acceptance_basis
tolerances.exact: Original IDs/strings, counts, axis coverage, grid/label support, declared source categories, source/method hashes and status/null support. Integral numeric notation/width may differ without changing value; bool is never a number.

serialization.csv: UTF-8 with required named columns, no duplicate headers or duplicate/missing keys; columns and rows may be reordered; harmless extra columns ignored. Finite decimal/scientific notation allowed, exactly integral integer fields accepted without lossy int(float) parsing. Undefined numeric cells are empty, never NaN/Inf strings.
serialization.json: Finite JSON only recursively; no duplicate object keys or NaN/Infinity/exponent overflow. Required numbers are JSON numbers, never Boolean/numeric strings. Required null fields explicit. Harmless descriptive extras allowed except closed source identities/group identities.
serialization.npz: Load with allow_pickle=False. Required numeric arrays must be real integer/float, never Boolean for integer or numeric quantities; no object arrays. Exactly integral finite real numeric key arrays within int64 accepted. All required numeric arrays finite; no inactive ROI slots or NaNs in a successful primary. String participant axis uses Unicode or UTF-8 byte arrays.
serialization.axis_joins: participant_id joins all NPZ participant axes to participants.csv; frame_index permutes axis1 of both timecourse tensors; parcel_id permutes axis2 and diagnostic ROI axes. Edge endpoints are original numeric parcel IDs, not positions in the submitted parcel axis, and jointly permute axis1 of r/z/positive matrices.
serialization.findings: Nonempty free text; no required keywords or literal explanatory sentence.

edge_j.type: integer original parcel ID, strictly greater than edge_i

residual_sd.type: finite positive real, source-defined support diagnostic

types.segregation: finite real or empty iff zero_within_mean

types.groups: object with exactly child and adult group_record values

types.mean: finite real or null iff undefined_member
types.sample_variance: finite nonnegative real or null iff undefined_member

types.estimate: finite real or null iff undefined_member
types.se: finite nonnegative real or null iff undefined_member
types.ci95: ordered two finite numbers or null iff undefined_member

run_metadata.json.source_sha256: Closed exact object of all86 manifest relative paths to their SHA256 values, including provenance; manifest itself is represented separately by source_manifest_sha256
run_metadata.json.method_contract_sha256: SHA256 of exact public method_contract.json bytes
run_metadata.json.source_manifest_sha256: SHA256 of exact authenticated public source_manifest.json bytes
run_metadata.json.software_versions: Nonempty object with nonempty string keys, actual values any finite JSON; independent implementation/library names allowed
run_metadata.json.warnings: Array of finite JSON diagnostic records; empty allowed; no exact prose/version gate

source_observed.bold_headers: 40 header_record objects keyed by exact participant_id, ordering irrelevant
source_observed.atlas_header: One header_record object without participant_id, for original atlas image

types.storage_dtype: exact original NIfTI storage dtype name

failure_policy.source_precondition: Missing/hash-mismatched/nonfinite/unsupported source, wrong cohort/grid/labels/confounds or numerically degenerate source parcel is failure, not an exclusion. Exit nonzero with a reason.
failure_policy.receipt: Create reserved failure_receipt.json exclusively with status=failed_precondition and a nonempty reason. Any existing failure_receipt.json, including dangling symlink, makes the output nongradable even when other success files remain.
failure_policy.no_overwrite: Require fresh output/evidence destinations, reject symlink paths/ancestors or source/output overlap. Preserve partial artifacts on failure; do not overwrite evidence or silently retry.
failure_policy.pilot: If a separately authorized resource pilot processes fewer than40, declare resource_pilot in results and metadata, preserve full source-authentication scope, and do not present partial summaries as the required full cohort. Pilot cannot pass full grading.
failure_policy.success: All seven required artifacts complete. Exact-zero within mean is a valid explicitly undefined endpoint, not a source-precondition failure.
